title: Speaking — Family celebrations
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on family celebrations.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
Which celebrations are important to your family?
What work normally goes into preparing a celebration?

part2.topic: Describe a celebration where several generations took part.
part2.closing: and explain what made the occasion enjoyable across different age groups.

questions: Why are certain celebrations simplified from one generation to the next?
Can large public celebrations bring together people from different backgrounds?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to family celebrations?
